{"id":2021903558,"question_id":4057,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 2 weeks","timestamp":1780551121,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"47 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2021903558/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Total Waviness of Numbers in Range I","memory":"9.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int totalWaviness(int num1, int num2) {\n        int peaks = 0;\n        int valleys = 0;\n        int waviness = 0;\n\n        for(int i = num1 ; i<=num2 ; i++)\n        {\n            string s = to_string(i);\n            if(s.size() < 3) waviness = 0;\n\n            for(int j = 1 ; j < s.size()-1 ; j++)\n            {\n                if(s[j] > s[j+1] && s[j] > s[j-1]) peaks++;\n                else if(s[j] < s[j+1] && s[j] < s[j-1]) valleys++;\n            }   \n        } \n\n        waviness = peaks + valleys;\n        return waviness;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"total-waviness-of-numbers-in-range-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2061}
